Here is a comprehensive summary of what Anthropic announced with the Claude Opus 4.7 launch in 2026:

---

**Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.7 Launch (April 16, 2026)**

Anthropic released Claude Opus 4.7 on April 16, 2026. The model is now generally available and is a notable improvement on Opus 4.6, particularly in advanced software engineering, with gains on the most difficult tasks. [1][2]

**Coding and Agentic Improvements**

Users report being able to hand off their hardest coding work — the kind that previously needed close supervision — to Opus 4.7 with confidence. The model handles complex, long-running tasks with rigor and consistency, pays precise attention to instructions, and devises ways to verify its own outputs before reporting back. [4] Claude Opus 4.7 is designed for complex coding, agent workflows, multimodal tasks, and professional knowledge work. [6]

**Vision Upgrades**

Opus 4.7 processes images at resolutions up to 2,576 pixels on the long edge, representing more than three times the capacity of prior Claude models. [8] It's also more tasteful and creative when completing professional tasks, producing higher-quality interfaces, slides, and docs. [4]

**New Developer Tools**

Anthropic introduced a new "xhigh" effort level between high and max, giving users finer control over the tradeoff between reasoning and latency on hard problems. In Claude Code, the default effort level was raised to xhigh for all plans. [4] On the API platform, Anthropic launched task budgets in public beta, and in Claude Code, a new `/ultrareview` slash command was introduced to produce a dedicated review session that flags bugs and design issues. [4]

**Cybersecurity Safeguards**

Opus 4.7 is the first model in which Anthropic experimented with efforts to differentially reduce cyber capabilities compared to Mythos Preview. It is being released with safeguards that automatically detect and block requests indicating prohibited or high-risk cybersecurity uses. [4] Security professionals wishing to use Opus 4.7 for legitimate cybersecurity purposes such as vulnerability research and penetration testing are invited to join Anthropic's new Cyber Verification Program. [4]

**Claude Design**

Alongside the model, Anthropic released Claude Design, a collaborative visual creation tool on April 17, 2026, that lets users generate designs, prototypes, slides, and marketing materials through natural-language prompts, powered by Claude Opus 4.7. [2]

**Availability**

Opus 4.7 is available across all Claude products and the API, Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Vertex AI, and Microsoft Foundry. [4]
